customer_reply:
Hello,

Thanks for contacting us. Here is how to resolve this: 'UOM invalid' means the unit of measure is not in the UOM master list. Use ISO codes (EA, BX, KG). Download current template v3 from Catalogs > Import > Template and map the UOM column; re-upload. If this doesn't fix it, reply with the exact error message or a screenshot and we'll take it to our L2 team.
